title: RepoDocs project configuration
description: Source repositories are scanned into the System IR. Exactly one repository, either a source repository or a destination-only repository, receives generated system documentation.

pinned_revision.description: Full commit SHA the repository is expected to be checked out at. Scans and generation fail when the checkout does not match.

output_directory.description: Dedicated generated-output directory, relative to the destination repository root.

ai.description: Optional AI interpretation. Absent means disabled. Credentials are never stored here.

external_consent.description: Explicit consent to send the redacted evidence bundle off this machine. False keeps the project local-only.

source_excerpts_consent.description: Explicit consent to send bounded, redacted source excerpts to an external provider for architecture discovery (ADR-026). Separate from external_consent, which never covers it.

source_consent_policy.description: The source-excerpt policy version the consent was given for. Consent for another version does not apply.

architecture.description: Optional limits for architecture discovery. Budgets may only be lowered from the defaults in ADR-026.

html_export.description: Also write the self-contained architecture-view.html. It embeds the pinned Mermaid bundle from tools/mermaid, so generation fails when the bundle is missing.
